# Rikugan (六眼)

> A reverse-engineering agent that runs natively inside IDA Pro and Binary Ninja.

Rikugan is a native C++ plugin. Its agent — turn loop, model providers and logins, sessions, compaction, retries, skills and MCP — is libomc (oh-my-c), linked in-process; Rikugan adds the host analysis tools, the chat panel, per-database chats, undo, modes, subagents, the bulk renamer, analysis profiles, and RE prompts and skills. It is not an MCP client: the agent talks to the database through Rikugan's own tools. Rikugan 1.x was a Python plugin; it remains only in the git history.

## Pages

- [Home](index.html): overview, features, skills, providers.
- [Documentation](docs.html): installation, models and accounts, settings, usage, commands, modes, skills, MCP, memory, profiles, tool reference.
- [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.html): libomc embedding, threads, chat lifecycle, system prompt, tool pipeline, undo, modes, subagents, bulk renamer, settings and files, security model.

## Key Facts

- **Hosts**: IDA Pro 9.3 (Hex-Rays for the decompiler tools) and Binary Ninja (UI mode). Linux, macOS and Windows 10/11 x64.
- **Models**: every provider and login libomc supports (Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini, Copilot, API keys …), any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, local servers (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp).
- **Tools**: 50 shared analysis tools, plus 12 Binary Ninja IL tools or 8 IDA microcode/pseudocode tools; chat tools (ask_user, save_memory, spawn_subagent, exploration_report, research_note; in Binary Ninja list_databases, open_database (opens a new tab) and ask_database); read/write/edit/grep/glob/bash/web_search/todo, each disk or shell kind asking once per chat.
- **Full window**: the header's expand button moves the chat into a window-sized tab with a list of every open database's chats; one click switches between them (IDA and Binary Ninja).
- **Binary Ninja MCP**: once Binary Ninja's own MCP server answers (Rikugan keeps probing; Settings → MCP → Address overrides where), the panel offers its tools (`bn_*`) per database. The header's MCP button switches a database between them and Rikugan's analysis tools. Their changes are not in `/undo`.
- **Skills**: 12 built-in; custom skills in `~/.rikugan/omc/agent/skills/<slug>/SKILL.md`.
- **Modes**: `/plan`, `/explore`, `/modify` (explore → plan → execute → save), `/research` (notes next to the database).
- **Undo**: `/undo [N]` reverses renames, comments and prototypes.
- **Script approval**: `execute_python` always asks; it runs in the host's own Python behind a guard.
- **Memory**: `RIKUGAN.md` next to the database, first 200 lines in the system prompt.
- **Profiles**: IOC redaction and denied tools apply to every tool result, omc's file, shell, web and MCP tools included.
- **Files**: settings in `~/.rikugan/config.json`; logins, MCP servers and skills in `~/.rikugan/omc/agent/`; chats in `~/.rikugan/sessions/`.

## Installation

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/buzzer-re/Rikugan/main/install.sh | bash          # Linux, macOS
```

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/buzzer-re/Rikugan/main/install.ps1 | iex                  # Windows
```

The installers download the release's prebuilt plugin for each host found, check it against its `.sha256` and unpack it into the host's plugins folder. To build from source: `./build.sh` (Linux, macOS) or `.\build.ps1` (Windows) write the same packages to `dist/`, and `./install.sh --from dist` / `.\install.ps1 -From dist` installs them. Binary Ninja plugins are tied to its API version: after a Binary Ninja update, install the matching release or rebuild.
